fact: The decree names ARTCI as the body that receives declarations, rules on authorisation requests within one month, and imposes withdrawals and fines under the 2013 law; it shows no appointment of members or acting decisions.

The ALT Advisory fact sheet says Law No. 2013-450 gives enforcement responsibilities to ARTCI, that a data protection authority is appointed, with 7 members serving up to 6 years; the page gives no date for the facts, so its published date is used.

fact: ARTCI, styling itself the Autorité de Protection des Données Personnelles, issued a communique on 3 August 2026 inviting controllers to use CERTINUM, which it says it launched on 2 July 2026, so the body is acting as the authority.
